definitions.n_obs: days with non-NaN Close on the ticker's calendar
definitions.n_gaps_gt5: gaps between consecutive observations with >5 missing trading days
definitions.status: active=last bar on 2026-09-25; ended_before_2026-09-25; no_data=Yahoo returned nothing for the symbol
definitions.member_*: overlap with D2-derived membership spells since 2000 (d2_universe_spells.csv)
definitions.reuse_suspect: Yahoo series starts after membership ended, or Yahoo name does not match any Wikipedia name for a non-current ticker
definitions.name_check: fuzzy token match of Yahoo longName vs Wikipedia names (current list + changes table)
